brand.name: Money Quest
cta_lines: Help your child build real-life skills.

_music_gain_note: 0.25 = quiet bed for notification publishing, where a TikTok sound is added in the app. Use 1.0 for fully automatic publishing.
_series_note: quotes = quotation series (curriculum/quotes.json); tips = parent problem-to-solution series (curriculum/topics.json).

quote_series._note: Average music level in dBFS. Typical TikTok music sits around -14; -31 is a very quiet bed.

publishing._note: Defaults for scheduled runs when the repository variables PUBLISH_MODE / AUTOMATION_ENABLED are not set. Allowed here: review, buffer-draft, buffer-notify. Automatic public posting can never be enabled from this file; it needs the repository variables PUBLISH_MODE=buffer-auto and PUBLIC_POSTING_APPROVED=true.
publishing._skip_note: Scheduled runs do nothing on these dates (UTC); the series simply continues on the next scheduled day.
